## Fixed
- **Improvements in a new version now reach mods that were already checked.** Source comparison results are remembered per mod file, so unchanged mods are not compared again. Until now that also kept results from the previous version of this app: for example, a mod falsely shown as "Differs from source" before v0.1.6 kept that result after updating. Remembered results now belong to the app version that made them, so after an update every mod is compared once more (about one GitHub request per mod).

## Download and verify
Download `CS2ModVerifier-v0.1.7-win-x64.zip`, extract it, and run `CS2ModVerifier.exe`. To update, exit the running app from the tray menu and replace the old `CS2ModVerifier.exe` with the new one. Your settings and ignored findings are kept.

**Windows SmartScreen will most likely warn you**, because the exe is not code-signed. Check the download first, then choose "More info" and "Run anyway".

This release was built by GitHub Actions from the tagged commit. To check that your download is that build:

```
gh attestation verify CS2ModVerifier.exe --repo KDanielK/CS2ModVerifier
```

Or compare the SHA-256 hash (`Get-FileHash CS2ModVerifier.exe`, or `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS.txt`) with `SHA256SUMS.txt`.

## Please note
CS2 Mod Verifier is an aid, not a guarantee of safety. No findings does not mean a mod is safe, and a finding does not mean a mod is harmful. See the README for what each check does and does not show.
